what_it_does: Maruti Suzuki India Limited manufactures and sells passenger vehicles, including small cars, SUVs, and light commercial vehicles, to domestic customers and global markets across over 100 countries, generating revenue primarily through vehicle sales, spare parts, and associated mobility services.
other_facts: Annual sales reached a record 2,422,713 vehicles in FY 2025-26 with exports of 447,774 vehicles.
The company operates manufacturing facilities across Haryana and Gujarat.
The sales and service network includes 5,242 sales outlets and 5,926 service outlets.
